bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.subtitle: Every booking on the platform, and what the weather is about to do to them.
bookings.riskSub: {forecast} kt forecast against this operator’s {limit} kt limit for {service}, {when}. Cancelling is one operation, and it reaches further than this departure.

money.title: Money
money.subtitle: What came in, what is owed out, and every leg that moved it.
money.payoutsSub: Gross, commission and fees stated separately — never one blended figure.
money.ledgerSub: Double-entry and append-only. There is no edit here: a correction is a new entry that reverses the one it replaces.
money.fxSub: Stored scaled by a million, and the rate a booking used is kept with the booking.

trust.title: Safety & trust
trust.subtitle: What went wrong, who is owed an answer, and what changed because of it.
trust.incidentsSub: A record, not a queue. Every report carries what changed as a result, and Dahab’s hyperbaric chamber is six minutes away.
trust.disputesSub: A resolution writes a ledger reversal, never an edit.
trust.impersonationSub: Support reproduces a fault as the user; it is not a way to browse as one. Time-boxed to {minutes} minutes, a reason is required, and a banner shows while it runs.

platform.title: Platform
platform.subtitle: The audit trail, the switches, the map and the seven languages.
platform.auditSub: The counterweight to an admin holding every permission: actor, permission, target and reason, on every action.
platform.translationsSub: How Arabic written by a Dahab operator reaches six other languages. Machine output still needs a human pass.
